entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah. I... I need to make a return. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into this for you. To start, could you please provide your order number?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. It's about a jersey I ordered. I've been a customer for so long, and I was really looking forward to it.
Thank you. I have your order right here. I'm sorry you're disappointed with the jersey. What specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just the wrong size. It's... it's much too tight, and it doesn't look right. I feel so bad about it, I was saving up for this and I really needed this money if it wasn't going to work out.
Oh, please don't feel bad at all! Sizing can be tricky online. Let me check the policy for you. I see the order was delivered 24 days ago.
Is that... is that going to be a problem? I really hoped I could get a refund.

Not a problem at all! For a standard item like this jersey, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can process a full refund for you right now, or if you'd like, I can help you with an exchange for the correct size.
Oh, really? You can do that? That's such a relief. I was so worried.

Absolutely. And I also see here that you're one of our VIP members. As a thank you for your loyalty, once I process this, I'm also going to add a 15% off coupon to your account for your next purchase. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to your email now.
Wow, Sarah. That is so incredibly kind. You've really made my day so much better. A refund would be perfect. Thank you so much!
You are most welcome. I've just processed the full refund. You should see it back in your account in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for being so helpful.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
